vibe: Build less, test targeted, and never cancel a full build.

assessment: This file demonstrates mature engineering taste by treating build and test time as a scarce resource, mandating targeted workflows and explicit time budgets. It balances agent autonomy with guardrails—such as the override matrix merge block and GPU test warnings—while insisting on consistency with existing code patterns. The result is a pragmatic, systems-level guide that prevents common agent failure modes like runaway builds or style drift.
